name: decision_router
description: Routes a conversation with a closed-set decision, or measures adaptive ladder suggestions in opt-in shadow mode without changing requests.

permissions.name: env.plugin_config
permissions.description: Read the routing question, confidence threshold, and operator-defined route map

permissions.name: env.http_request
permissions.description: Ask the approved System One endpoint for a closed-set route decision

permissions.name: env.credential_get
permissions.description: Read the separately bound API key when bearer authentication is enabled

permissions.name: env.state_get
permissions.description: Read the route already chosen for this conversation and exact policy

permissions.name: env.state_set
permissions.description: Remember the chosen route across turns and Torana restarts

permissions.name: env.route_request
permissions.description: Apply only a provider/model route explicitly configured by the operator

permissions.name: env.emit_metric
permissions.description: Count routing, sticky reuse, and bounded fallback outcomes

permissions.name: env.log
permissions.description: Report value-free fallback reasons without prompts, responses, or credentials

credentials.description: Bearer token for an authenticated System One endpoint
